android.desc:
Lifescreen visualizes your whole life on a single phone screen, inspired by the “Your Life in Weeks” concept.

Enter your birth date and see your entire life as a 90×52 grid—each square represents a week.

Notifications show your current age, week, and day, updating automatically at midnight.

You can also set a special deadline by a certain age and see exactly how much time is left until you reach that age—both on the main screen and in the notification.

Designed to be simple: no onboarding, no registration. It's meant like this—run the app and forget about it. Come back only when you wonder, "Where am I in my life?"

Features:
- Life visualized in weeks (90×52 grid)
- Persistent notification with your age and week progress
- Countdown to your personal deadline
- Light and dark themes
- Smooth, minimal interface
